messages.subject: DSsim - left truncation
parts:
Dear Usergroup,

This question relates to the DSim package.

I am trying to figure out if it is possible to add a left displacement when defining the analysis (make.ddf.analysis.list). Based on how I would implement this in mrds I tried the following:

ddf.analyses <- make.ddf.analysis.list(dsmodel = list(~cds(key = "hn",formula = ~1),
                                                                      meta.data=list(left=8, width=25)),
                                                           method = "ds",
                                                           criteria = "AIC",
                                                           truncation = 25)

This doesn't work. Alternatively I might be able to use a function when setting the truncation variable? Not yet succeeded. Maybe anyone on the list has managed - or maybe it is not possible?

Many thanks for your time.

Don
